svg.aria-label: Selected work: Tifflo (MVP · live): Delivery tracking for home-meal providers, run over WhatsApp. Replaced WhatsApp threads and spreadsheets with one source of truth.; Agua India (Production · 4 cities): Water delivery backend for 20,000+ users across India. 20% faster delivery processing, 40% higher vendor sales productivity, 99% uptime.; Grocify.ai (MVP): Weekly meal plans and pantry tracking inside WhatsApp. 10+ active users planning 21+ meals a week. Most replies under 500 ms.; Food For All (Hackathon · Fosshack 3): Matches surplus restaurant food with nearby NGOs. Replaced ad-hoc WhatsApp coordination with a structured workflow.

g.text: How each one works, and the decision behind it.

text.tspan: Delivery tracking for home-meal providers, run over
WhatsApp.
Replaced WhatsApp threads and spreadsheets with one source of
truth.
Meal counts are a ledger, not a number.
Every delivery, pause and
skip is an entry, so any count can be traced and any mistake
reversed.
Water delivery backend for 20,000+ users across India.
20% faster delivery processing, 40% higher vendor sales
productivity, 99% uptime.
Fix the slow paths before adding features.
Query optimization
and geospatial indexing came first, then a real-time vendor
dashboard.
Weekly meal plans and pantry tracking inside WhatsApp.
10+ active users planning 21+ meals a week. Most replies under
Live inside WhatsApp instead of shipping an app.
Onboarding
costs nothing. The hard part became keeping multi-step
conversations consistent.
Matches surplus restaurant food with nearby NGOs.
Replaced ad-hoc WhatsApp coordination with a structured
workflow.
A fast match beats the best match.
Food spoils in hours, so any
nearby NGO alerted quickly is worth more than a perfect one alerted
late.
